methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 11 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Athanor operates in Robotics & Manufacturing, a sector encompassing 11 peer companies across public and private markets. The comp universe includes one publicly traded peer (277810.KQ) and eight private peers, with top-tier private comparables including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics. The target's current valuation and stage remain undisclosed, limiting precision in peer stratification.

Peer-median valuation methodology proved inapplicable. The analysis identified 11 same-sector peers but zero matches meeting narrow stage and valuation-tier filters simultaneously. This absence of three or more comparable datapoints at similar stage and tier makes sector-wide median unreliable as a primary valuation anchor. No triangulated valuation range can be supported by the available data.

Without disclosed financial metrics, stage clarity, or a sufficiently dense peer cohort at matching maturity levels, quantitative valuation synthesis is not defensible at this time. Key uncertainties blocking analysis include: lack of stage specification, absence of revenue or growth benchmarks, and insufficient narrow-fit comparables in a fragmented robotics market. Future valuation work requires either (1) stage and financial data disclosure, or (2) identification of additional same-stage private peers with known valuations. The single public comparable provides limited insight without stated operational parallels to the target.
